# The Allodium

> A free, ad-free public index of published psychotherapy research and
> client resources. Every entry carries published verification provenance —
> DOI identity checks against Crossref/OpenAlex, legitimacy triage, and live
> link-health status — so a source can be judged before it's followed. No
> accounts, no cookies, no tracking.

The Allodium indexes metadata and outbound links only. It does not host or
republish full text, abstracts, or copyrighted files.

## Key pages

- [Search](https://theallodium.org/psychotherapy/search): keyword search
  over the full psychotherapy collection.
- [The Standard](https://theallodium.org/standard): the verification
  methodology — identity checks, legitimacy triage, link-health gates — and
  live coverage numbers for the current published snapshot.
- [Disclaimer](https://theallodium.org/disclaimer): scope, limitations, and
  crisis resources.
- [Sitemap](https://theallodium.org/sitemap.xml): machine-readable list of
  every entry and static route.
